title: Discovery
done when: From a mock discovery call you produce notes in which every answer is mapped to the deployment decision it changes.

title: Qualification and sizing
done when: You turn discovery notes into a deployment hypothesis: model, GPUs, serverless or dedicated, quantization, and a cost range, with the math shown.

title: Performance testing engagements
done when: You write a benchmark plan from a customer traffic sample and a results report with curves and goodput under their SLO, promising nothing the data does not show.

title: POC and evaluation
done when: You write a POC plan with success criteria tied to SLOs and eval parity, owners, timeline, and exit criteria.

title: Migration and cutover
done when: You write a migration plan with chat-template and sampling parity checks, shadow traffic, canary, cutover, and rollback.

title: Commercials and security
done when: You build a TCO comparison of serverless, dedicated, and self-hosting with a breakeven point, and can walk a security questionnaire.

title: Escalation and handoff
done when: You write an escalation report the performance team can act on without a follow-up question.
